gloss: high-class shop; upscale restaurant; luxury establishment

definitions.gloss: upscale shop or restaurant; luxury establishment
definitions.explanation: A shop, restaurant, or other establishment of high quality and price, catering to wealthy customers. Covers both food and retail contexts.

examples.japanese: {高級店|こうきゅうてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ディナー→ディナー：27996_dinaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had dinner at an upscale restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀座|ぎんざ}→銀座：30631_ginza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高級店|こうきゅうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Upscale shops line the streets of Ginza.

examples.japanese: {高級店|こうきゅうてん}⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧、⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見合|みあ}う→見合う：14391_miau⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別問題|べつもんだい}だ。
examples.english: Even if it is an upscale establishment, whether it offers value for the service is a separate question.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: high-end restaurant (more specific to dining)
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧: long-established shop — emphasizes history and tradition rather than price or luxury
- ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧: department store — may contain high-end sections but is not itself a 高級店

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高級店|こうきゅうてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to an upscale establishment
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦{和食店|わしょくてん}→和食店：25455_washokuten⟧: high-end Japanese restaurant
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: luxury brand store
